title: Stand-Down Picks
eyebrow: GPOM second half · scene A · picks
heading: The stand-down: stop short, don't reverse
intro: Your note: the kill bot reverses at the stand-down. These six stills have the bots charging from far off and stopping well short of the door. The HUD (NEW OBJECTIVE: SUSTAIN ORGANIC LIFE) goes on top. Pick one and I animate it (slowing from speed to a dead stop, dust overtaking). Claude's pick: sd-01.

sections.lede: The shot before (the wide approach, your pick wa-02) and what's in the cut now (the bot reverses under this HUD).
Pick one. A note on the row is welcome.

groups.title: Stand-down plate (under the HUD)
groups.line: Bots stop well short of the door, no backing up.

opts.label: sd-01: braked dead over the hull (Claude's pick). Same view as now, furrows end under the tracks, door small under the reticle
sd-02: the pack pulls up ahead of us. Ties to wa-02's pack; still could read as moving
sd-03: along the gun barrel, door far and sharp
opts.warn: barrel reads as aiming, not standing down

opts.label: sd-04: wa-02's own camera a moment later, pack halted in a line
opts.warn: not the bot's view, so the HUD reads as surveillance

opts.label: sd-05: tracks dug in, turf piled up. Strongest dead stop; door a bit off the reticle
sd-06: low on one track, chalk gouge, door tiny
opts.warn: better as an insert than under the HUD
